claim_boundary: C014 uses deterministic seed 9379992 to choose canonical bridge edges and adds six descendants born from exact attacks. None is claimed novel or promoted to PROVED.

hypotheses.title: Seeded Arch-Connected Standard-Theta Twin Family Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: Using seed 9379992, choose the canonical zero-primal-entry pairs (31,22) on the H098 SAT graph and (22,13) on the H098 UNSAT graph. For every r at least one, take r copies of each graph and connect consecutive copies by the corresponding arch edge. Both resulting graphs are connected, have exact Lovasz theta value 8r, the SAT-side graph has alpha 8r, and the UNSAT-side graph has alpha at most 7r.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The standard first-theta collision persists on an explicit connected family, so disconnected disjoint-union structure is not the source of the blind spot.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: turn the H098-H099 collision into a connected exact obstruction by adding only edges on zero entries of the amplified primal certificate.
hypotheses.next_gate: Obtain independent replay of the seed-derived arches and determine which connected arched graphs are realizable as standard conflict graphs of explicit CNFs or CSPs.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H104 adds deterministic zero-entry bridge edges that connect every copy while preserving exact primal and dual certificates and opposite alpha labels.
falsification_conditions: A seed-derived arch has a nonzero entry in the amplified primal matrix.
Either arched graph is disconnected or its exact theta certificate fails.
The SAT witness contains an arch edge or the UNSAT alpha upper bound is invalid.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The arched objects are connected graph-level twins obtained from CNF conflict graphs by adding edges; they are not yet claimed to be standard conflict graphs of the original CNFs.

hypotheses.title: Typed Interface to d-DNNF Transfer Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: Every explicit Boolean interface circuit satisfying H102's syntax is a deterministic decomposable negation normal form of the same asymptotic size: each AND gate is decomposable because its children have disjoint original-variable support, and each OR gate is deterministic by certificate. Therefore a polynomial-size H102 compiler for every CNF would yield polynomial-size d-DNNFs for every CNF.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Known explicit exponential DNNF lower bounds directly destroy H102 and identify support overlap or nondeterminism as necessary escape resources for any surviving interface compiler.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: make the H102-to-DNNF translation explicit enough to carry the unconditional lower bound without a projection loophole.
hypotheses.next_gate: Independently audit leaf semantics and verify that no hidden auxiliary-variable projection remains in the exact H102 statement.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H105 isolates the exact same-size syntactic translation that turns H102's repaired interface language into the lower-bound model that destroyed H016.
falsification_conditions: An H102-legal gate whose AND children share an original variable or whose OR alternatives overlap semantically.
An output semantics requiring existential projection not present in the explicit circuit over original variables.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: This is a transfer lemma for the exact H102 syntax, not a lower bound for arbitrary interface circuits with overlap or nondeterminism.

hypotheses.title: Oblivious Constant-Pass Local Treewidth Compiler Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants q,r,c and a finite signed-incidence rewrite grammar such that exactly q synchronous passes are applied, every output symbol has a radius-qr ancestry in the original incidence graph, no persistent work-tape state or adaptive scheduler is allowed, and every length-N CNF is mapped to a polynomial-size equisatisfiable CNF of primal treewidth at most c log N with polynomial witness recovery.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Bounded-treewidth dynamic programming would decide SAT in polynomial time through a compiler that cannot hide an unbounded sequential SAT computation.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: salvage the local-treewidth route after H100's undefined potential and global-channel prohibition failed to define a falsifiable mechanism.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove a locality lower bound on expander or lifted formulas for every fixed q,r grammar, or exhibit one complete grammar and verify witness recovery.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H106 replaces the undefined decreasing potential by a fixed constant number of synchronous passes and an explicit ancestry radius, preventing a hidden polynomial-time work tape.
falsification_conditions: An explicit CNF family whose every q-pass radius-r image retains omega(log N) treewidth or superpolynomial size.
A proof that the stated ancestry restriction still permits arbitrary polynomial-time global computation.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: No universal compiler is known. The fixed-pass condition is intentionally much narrower than H009 and H100.

hypotheses.title: One-Pass Gadget Pseudoexpectation Transport Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every fixed one-pass bounded-radius signed-incidence transduction allowed by H103 and every degree-2k source pseudoexpectation, there is a uniformly constructible degree-O(k) pseudoexpectation on the output graph whose local moments depend only on the source neighborhood and gadget type, with polynomial-bit descriptions for fixed k.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Any explicit source family with persistent bounded-degree pseudoexpectations would remain invisible to the output first-theta relaxation, creating a route to refute every H103 compiler at once.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: build the missing arch from H088's local gadget analysis and H104's connected collision to a universal one-pass theta-gap obstruction.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define the overlap consistency equations for adjacent gadgets and prove the transport for one nontrivial signed clause-variable transduction.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H107 specializes pseudoexpectation transport to the exact nonadaptive compiler class left alive by H103 and requires a uniform local moment construction.
falsification_conditions: A fixed one-pass gadget whose output destroys every bounded-degree source pseudoexpectation while preserving the reduction semantics.
A necessary output degree growing with instance size rather than k and the fixed radius.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H104 alone does not prove H107 because its added graph arches need not be outputs of every allowed CNF transduction.

hypotheses.title: Minor-Bounded Rational LDL Bit-Complexity Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: For every n by n rational positive-semidefinite matrix with total binary encoding length L, there exists a symmetrically permuted exact LDL factorization whose complete rational certificate has total bit length polynomial in n and L. After clearing denominators, fraction-free symmetric elimination expresses pivots and multipliers as ratios of integer minors, whose bit lengths are polynomially bounded by Hadamard's inequality.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The asymptotic certificate-size gate left open in H092 closes: exact rational PSD verification has polynomial-size witnesses for every explicit rational PSD input.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: convert H092's exact constructor into a bit-sensitive certificate theorem using determinant bounds rather than empirical fraction growth.
hypotheses.next_gate: Obtain independent review of the minor identities for pivoted singular PSD elimination and formalize one explicit polynomial bound.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H108 supplies the missing determinant-based bit-length argument for rational LDL certificates and adds seed-9379992 stress fixtures without treating them as proof.
falsification_conditions: A rational PSD family whose every permuted LDL certificate requires superpolynomial bit length in the input encoding.
A pivoted elimination entry that cannot be represented by polynomial-bit ratios of input minors.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The proof remains a lemma candidate pending independent audit; the seeded stress suite is only finite evidence for the implementation.

hypotheses.title: Bounded-Norm Strict Dual Rounding Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: In the fixed H093 graph dual, suppose a real witness has slack S at least delta I, objective t at most M-gamma, and every multiplier and t has absolute value at most 2^B. Rounding all coordinates to a common dyadic grid of mesh epsilon at most min(gamma/2,delta/(2(m+1))) yields a rational dual witness with slack at least delta/2 I, objective at most M-gamma/2, and total binary encoding length polynomial in the graph size, B, log(1/delta), and log(1/gamma). Combined with H108, it has a polynomial-size exact LDL certificate.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: A well-conditioned bounded-norm numerical dual gap can be converted into an exact polynomial-bit H094 UNSAT certificate, isolating coefficient magnitude as the missing hypothesis in H097.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: provide a quantitative rounding arch between strict numerical feasibility and exact rational theta certificates.
hypotheses.next_gate: Independently check the operator-norm perturbation constant for the chosen edge matrices and determine whether a polynomial multiplier bound follows from H097's original assumptions.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H109 adds the explicit multiplier-norm promise absent from H097 and gives a direct dyadic rounding bound preserving both PSD margin and objective gap.
falsification_conditions: A bounded-norm strict dual witness for which the stated dyadic mesh destroys feasibility or the objective gap.
An edge-constraint matrix norm exceeding the perturbation accounting in the fixed H093 normalization.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The lemma does not derive a bounded multiplier norm from Slater margins alone and therefore does not by itself prove H097.
